about_the_game:
The factory floor is cold. The forge burns hot. Nations are going to war, and they need guns.Artillery Tycoon drops you into the cutthroat world of military manufacturing at the dawn of modern warfare. You're not just building weapons—you're engineering the thunder that decides which flags fly and which empires fall.

ENGINEER

Design artillery from the ground up. Research authentic breech mechanisms, recoil systems, and firing platforms. Every component matters. Attach the hull. Select your crew—commander, gunners, loaders. Configure your ordinance. Test fire at the range. Miss, and you lose the contract. Hit your marks, and nations will pay fortunes for your firepower.

BUILD

Transform raw steel into instruments of war. Manage production lines running 24/7. Speed up time and watch your factory churn out the French 75, the British 18-pounder, weapons that will reshape battlefields across continents. Expand your facilities. Unlock new research. Automate production. Save your designs and scale up—from one prototype to an arsenal.

DOMINATE

Win contracts from governments desperate for an edge. Outbid rival manufacturers. Deliver on time or watch your reputation crumble. Every nation at war needs artillery. The question is: will they buy yours?There are no second chances when your weapons fail on the battlefield. There are no refunds when shells miss their targets. This is industrial warfare. This is capitalism with a body count.Your factory. Your designs. Your empire. Build it or die trying.
detailed_description:
April Update

Hello everyone!

I have managed to build a Alpha version of the game that I'm aiming to release on April 30th!

Please note that it's currently up for Steam review so the date might change and also please note that this is a Alpha version and there will be some bugs. I hope that you are willing to try the game and that you are able to see the potential in it as much as I can. I will keep you guys updated.

Please note that I also setup a Discord channel, this will be used later on when the game is released for bug reporting and also if anyone have any ideas or thoughts about the game. head over there now and join us while we wait.


Second uodate!

I'm happy to let you guys know we are continuing to develop the game and in the last couple of weeks I have been working on mostly programming the different functions of the game but I have also updated the main screen and the factory screen to improve the feel for the game play.

If you haven't already please go and Wishlist the game. I'm a small game developer so wish listing the game will show me your support! Thank you!


March update

We have continued to work on the different features of the game to get the game closer to release and also updated the main screen for more details and updated the different stages for a few of the artillery pieces. We have much work ahead of us in March and hope we can get closer to a release before the summer! Please show your support and wish list the game and keep following us for  ore updates. If you have any questions or ideas just let me know! Thanks!


Roadmap!

Hello everyone!

I saw a post where it was suggested this is a scam game due to lack of information and and road map. So let me present to you what the road map and future updates will look like.

I'm aiming to do a major update roughly every 3 months, how ever now int he beginning there will probably be more smaller updates.

There are several mechanics that will be included in the game in the future:

-Office, you'll need to manage employees, hire and fire engineers and workers and manage your buildings

  • Battel notifications, there will be detailed reviews of how the artillery behaves in battles and how effective they are.

  • A world map to let you know where they are being used

  • Improved graphics, this will be a ongoing process and I will try to improve sections as we go along, the first step is to incorporate the mechanics then make sure they look nice

  • Shooting range, will add manual aiming and also add a 5 shot series so you get get a average of how your gun is performing

  • More guns! I aim to always add a few more pieces of artillery for every major update, the first ones should be added in roughly a week

  • Sound, yes it gets pretty quiet playing sometimes so I want to have some sounds included in the next update

  • News, we need to know what's going on in the world and who's fighting with who

  • Shipping, right now UPS comes and picks up and ships your artillery pieces for free, but that's not going to last forever, a shipping and logistics function will also be added

    These are some of the major items that will be added as we go along. I'm also very interested in any suggestions you players might have and if you feel there is anything missing or that should be added.


Update!

Hello everybody!

There is finally a update for the game that I hope will bring you more game time and some new challenges.

Here are some of the updates:

  • Two new pieces of artillery

    Feldhaubitz 14

    British 18-pounder

  • Loan function 

  • I have added some sound to a few locations

  • Possibility to skip the tutorial

  • There is now a 5-shot series in the shooting range that will give you a average of it's accuracy

  • Increased game speed

  • Fixed several small bugs


July Update

Hello everybody and thank you for the continued support!

I just wanted to share some more information on when the next update should be expected.

It's my ambition to start work on the next update in 4-6 weeks and I hope that I can release it within 10-12 weeks. 

Work will continue to add more mechanics to the game and once work has started I will let you know what the next update will contain.

Thank you again for your patience and I hope you have a great summer!


November update

Hello everybody and thank you for all your patience!

Work on the biggest update so far for the game is coming to a end in the next few weeks!

Most of the new mechanics and updated graphics are in place and the only thing left to do is to test it before I release it to you guys.

I hope this update will provide you with a great new experience and many hours of game play.

Stay tuned!


December update!

Entrepreneurs, the moment you've been waiting for has arrived! Artillery Tycoon's largest update to date is now live, packed with game-changing features, quality-of-life improvements, and stunning visual upgrades that will transform your weapons manufacturing empire.

What's New?

Gameplay Enhancements Difficulty Settings Added - Customize your experience! Choose the challenge level that's right for you, from casual entrepreneur to hardcore arms dealer

Skip Tutorial Option - Veterans can now jump straight into the action

Interchangeable Parts System - Mix and match components between different gun models for greater flexibility and efficiency

Expanded Global Market - More countries are now available as buyers for your military hardware

Rebalanced Research Costs - We've fine-tuned the progression system for a more rewarding experience

Visual Overhaul

Complete Graphics Update - The firing range has been rebuilt from the ground up with stunning new visuals

Redesigned Artillery Models - Every weapon system now features enhanced graphics and detail

Range Indicator System - New color-coded indicators on the shooting range show you exactly when targets are in or out of range

Refreshed Contracts Screen - Cleaner, more intuitive interface for managing your deals

Quality of Life

Authentic Naming - Parts and artillery pieces now use their proper designations for added realism

Warehouse Audio Fix - We heard you loud and clear - the forklift beep has been silenced! (Our sanity thanks you) Plus dozens of smaller improvements and polish updates

Jump Back In Whether you're a returning player or new to the world of artillery manufacturing, there's never been a better time to build your weapons empire. The enhanced graphics, refined gameplay systems, and expanded options make this the definitive Artillery Tycoon experience. Download or update Artillery Tycoon now and experience the biggest evolution of the game yet!

name: Artillery Tycoon

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with at least 1 GB dedicated memory (e.g., NVIDIA GTX 650, AMD Radeon HD 7770, or newer integrated graphics like Intel UHD 630)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loads; Laptop versions are fine on high-performance mode
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core 3.0 GHz (e.g., Intel Core i5 from 2011 or AMD Ryzen 3)
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with at least 2 GB dedicated memory (e.g., NVIDIA GTX 1050, AMD Radeon RX 560 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loads; Laptop versions are fine on high-performance mode

short_description: Build and manage an artillery factory in the WWI era. Research authentic weapon components, engineer deadly firepower, test prototypes on your firing range, and compete for lucrative government contracts. From the French 75 to the German 7.7, your designs will decide the fate of nations.
